change: CRITICAL FIX: S.appointments was never given the transaction-based sync protection entries/inspections/bayAssignments/supportJobs/deptETDs/knownIssues/jobUpdates already had — it was falling into the plain wholesale restWrite, so any device saving with a stale local appointments array could silently wipe out another device's brand-new appointment on its next save. This is the root cause of appointments (e.g. T811 DZU) disappearing from Incharge Queue and Security's Link dropdown with no trace in History. Now uses the same transaction-merge pattern, plus the periodic/on-visible self-healing resync and offline-write recovery now also cover appointments.
